name: Bomui Sorineun Machi Neowa Dalmaseo
source:
Aihara Airi, struggling with the feeling of being lost on a dark night, happens to hear the singing voice of Aozaki Aoi, and the story of two begins.
Set in an all-girls Japanese school, this kinetic novel tells a story of growth and love as two girls meet and help each other find a path to follow, one step at a time.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304840/]Steam[/url]]
